what_changed_today: PRICE RECLAIMED THE 50-DAY AND NEGATED THE BREAKDOWN: close 7,509.20 (~+0.9% vs prior 7,443.28) pushed back above the 50-day (7,470), the 23.6% fib (7,498) and the 38.2% fib (7,448), reversing the two-session loss of the SMA cluster and pulling back within ~0.9% of the 6/15 swing high (7,578).

MONTE CARLO NEUTRALIZED TO A NEAR-EVEN COIN FLIP: adjusted prob_up_first recovered to 51.4% (from 32.7% prior down-first skew) with median days upside 5d / downside 5d — the decisive down-skew has fully unwound but the edge fails all regime thresholds (65/70/75).
VIX EASED BACK TO 17.05 (from ~18.77): volatility slipped off its 50-day MA back toward the middle of the standard operating band, restoring a calmer backdrop.
ERP CUSHION REMAINS PINNED AT THE CEILING: forward earnings yield 5.02% vs 10-year 4.628% leaves ERP at 0.39%, still at the bottom of the valuation-ceiling band (10-year up slightly from 4.598%).
CREDIT SPREAD TIGHTENED BACK TO ITS AVERAGE: junk spread 1.28 sits right at its ~1.283 average after the July spike, easing the prior credit-widening warning back to neutral.
narrative_summary: Late Bull / Topping holds. Price snapped back above the 50-day, 23.6% and 38.2% fibs today, negating the two-day breakdown and re-approaching the repeatedly-rejected 6/15 swing high at 7,578. But the recovery is mechanically thin: Monte Carlo has only neutralized to a 51.4% coin flip that fails every regime threshold, ERP is pinned at 0.39% at the valuation ceiling, and McClellan breadth (~872, near its lows) plus soft net new highs still refuse to confirm the price move. Posture stays trim bias — patience over aggression until breadth confirms a breakout or price offers a deeper, better-confirmed pullback.
open_questions: Does the reclaim of the 50-day convert into a decisive breakout above the 6/15 swing high (7,578), or is this the sixth-plus tag-and-stall in the topping range?
Will McClellan breadth (~872, near its lows) and net new 52-week highs (~1.9) roll over further to confirm narrow leadership, or stabilize and diverge bullishly to validate the recovery?
Can ERP rebuild any cushion if the 10-year eases, or does it stay pinned at the valuation ceiling capping upside?

Price reclaimed the 23.6% (7,498) and 38.2% (7,448) fibs today, negating the two-session breakdown below the SMA cluster.
VIX eased to 17.05, back into the standard operating band and off its 50-day MA — no volatility stress.
Junk bond spread tightened to 1.28, right at its ~1.283 average, easing the prior credit warning back to neutral.
Rally Exhaustion Score is Low with full drift applied; drift path points to 7,547 (20d) and 7,625 (60d).
Forward PE 19.92x sits in the moderate 18-20x band, not stretched on an earnings-multiple basis.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Price reclaimed the 50-day and fib support today, VIX eased, and credit spreads tightened back to their average — the recovery is re-asserting.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: McClellan breadth (~872) sits near its 1-year lows and net new 52-week highs (~1.9) are barely positive, so the price move is driven by narrow leadership — a classic topping tell even before price breaks down.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: When breadth and credit both diverge from price, elevate caution even if price has not yet broken down; narrow leadership warns of a topping process.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Forward PE 19.92x is in the moderate 18-20x band and the trend structure (50d > rising 200d) remains bullish, supporting continued upside.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: ERP of 0.39% sits in the 0.0-0.5% valuation-ceiling band with the 10-year at 4.628% — equities offer almost no premium over risk-free yield, mandating trim bias and no aggressive adds.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: ERP of 0.0% to 0.5% is a valuation ceiling: trim bias, no aggressive adds.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: The prior hard down-first skew (67-73%) has fully unwound; adjusted prob_up_first recovered to 51.4% with balanced 5d/5d median days as price reclaimed support.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: A 51.4% up-first edge is a near-even coin flip that fails all three regime thresholds (65/70/75), so the setup is not actionable and provides no quantitative confirmation of the reclaim.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: Never use Monte Carlo in isolation; if the adjusted probability does not meet the regime threshold, the setup is not actionable.

primary_tension: A structurally intact bull skeleton that reclaimed the SMA cluster and fib support today is colliding with late-cycle confirmation failure: a Monte Carlo edge that has only neutralized to a 51.4% coin flip failing every regime threshold, a zero-cushion ERP (0.39%) pinned at the valuation ceiling, and McClellan breadth near its lows with weak net new highs that still refuse to confirm the multi-week recovery into repeatedly-rejected resistance.
